catalog.nvfp4Search: Blackwell GPU ine ndangariro yakakwana yaonekwa. Sarudzo NVFP4 zvakasiyana-siyana kana zvivakwa neinjini zvichizvitsigira. Native FLUX.2 Klein 4B Kurodha zvakanaka kunowanikwa munzvimbo dzemuno; tarisa CUDA PyTorch, zvinongoenderana nesarudzo, mamodheru anofambidzana uye memory yemahara usati wadhaunirodha. Kuonekwa kwe Hardware hakusimbise iyo yakagadziriswa nguva yekumhanya kana vimbiso yekumhanya.
catalog.nvfp4Prefer: NVFP4 inokurudzirwa kune iyi GPU uye FLUX.2 Klein 4B mhuri. Native loading inoda dhizaini yeComfy inotsigirwa, CUDA PyTorch uye zvinongodiwa. Sarudza mufananidzo wemufananidzo, Qwen3 encoder uye VAE zvakasiyana mumasetin'i eKugadzira. Iyo yekumhanyisa nguva, musanganiswa wakazara uye yemahara ndangariro ichiri kuda kuongororwa.
catalog.nvfp4Check: NVFP4 yakaonekwa: kugona kweGPU, ndangariro yemahara, uremu dhizaini kana tsigiro yekuvaka haina kusimbiswa. Tarisa injini yeCUDA usati wasarudza iyi mutsauko. Iyo fomati chete haigadziri kuenderana.
catalog.nvfp4Unsupported: Native NVFP4 hazvikurudzirwe ne GPU kana yemahara VRAM. Funga nezve GGUF inoenderana quantization kana injini inoenderana. Iyo nzira haipe yemuno FP4 kukurumidza.
catalog.quantQualityAdvice: Novera GGUF nhungamiro yezvinyorwa, mufananidzo nemavhidhiyo: Q6_K kana kupfuura ndiyo nzvimbo yedu yatinofunga pekutangira patinokoshesa kuvimbika; Q4_K_M inoenzanisa kunaka uye ndangariro. Aya ndiwo anorudziro, kwete chikumbaridzo chechokwadi chepasi rose. Zvigumisiro zvinoenderana nemuenzaniso uye basa. NVFP4 nezvimwe zvirongwa zvehuwandu zvinoda kuenderana kwavo uye kuongororwa kwemhando.
